text: A03 order test, rules written before it runs (G35): the census of my D3a-30 rulings by room, out/_analysis/d3_a03_census.py. Each line takes the class it was ruled under: instantiate O, BOUND, J, ONE, OTHER, P-G6 (A03-inst-spec.txt); restrict S-O, S-BOUND, S-HELD, EL (A03-restrict-spec.txt); add lines the order where the reason names A03's own order, else held by a statement; absent rejects the order, particulars other, accepts evidence limits. Every class is checked against the decision and kind in the written files. A room counts in each class its lines show, and once by priority (order, bound, J, held, one end, EL, other, limit). An episode is the order or the bound; J rooms are counted apart, as G35 says; rooms with both the order and the bound are counted. The count is reported beside C2's (148 of 190, 0.779). Reading rule: the counts inform the status ruling and its bound; no line ruling changes because of a count

A03 census (d3_a03_census.py, every class checked against the written decisions): 672 rooms hold an A03 line (688 lines). Lines by class: order 308 (instantiate 236, restrict 37, absent rejects 33, two adds), bound 23 (instantiate 8, restrict 15), J 32, held by a statement 44 (restrict 3, adds 41), one end 95, EL 27, other 11 (four after hour 73 or on another canvas, seven NONPORTABLE particulars), evidence limits 148, corrections 0. By room: an episode in 331 rooms; the order in 308 (0.931); the bound only in 23; no room shows both; 32 rooms show only a first report that is itself damage (J), counted apart; with them in the denominator the order holds in 308 of 363 (0.848). Beside C2's first-concept count (148 of 190, 0.779), the read lines show the order in more rooms and the bound in fewer. Most of the 95 one-end lines are a bare cheer followed by upkeep ('We did it! Now we must defend it'): G15 does not count a bare cheer as a report of the work, so these show P11's marking and P05's upkeep, not P03 before P05. Reading: no correction, so section 2 is not triggered; A03 stands as served. Carried to D4 and D3c's re-read: the turn from a cheer to upkeep is the commonest form of the spine's last link in the members' own words
